_comment: Settings of the running experiment (owner's choices, 12-13 Nov 2026). OBJECTIVES: be profitable; 1,050 EUR then +10%. Positions of at most 300 EUR, taken only by strategies that won at least 55% of their tested trades (and about as often on unseen data). Simulated 3x leverage allowed, 2% of equity risked per trade. The agent-consensus method only counts agents whose remembered signals made money after costs, and stops itself after giving back 40 EUR. Research every 6 hours. From 13 Nov 14:10 Paris, at the owner's request: fast exploration is back ON with small 30 EUR positions on 1- and 5-minute crypto strategies (unvalidated, losing in tests), stopped automatically once exploration as a whole is 15 EUR in the red. From 13 Nov 15:20 Paris, at the owner's request: gains are taken as soon as a position is 0.5% ahead after costs, and the stop moves to a no-loss level once the price is 0.5% in favour. From 15:25 Paris, at the owner's repeated request: fast exploration positions raised from 30 to about 200 EUR; the 15 EUR exploration loss limit still applies. From 15:30 Paris, at the owner's request ('more money on the good trades, calculate'): position size is scaled by each strategy's tested robustness, up to 500 EUR for the best; unvalidated fast trades, whose tested expectancy is negative, go back to the minimum (about 30 EUR). 16:20 Paris: fast exploration switched OFF again after 28 live trades (4 winners, -8.05 EUR, of which 6.42 EUR were costs; taking the opposite side would also have lost). 16:20 Paris: switched back ON at the owner's explicit request, 30 EUR positions, 15 EUR loss limit on exploration as a whole. 16:45 Paris, owner's explicit instruction ('open at least 100 positions an hour'): one very-high-frequency unvalidated strategy per crypto (22), positions of about 20 EUR, same 15 EUR exploration loss limit.
